bodyMarkdown:
## Converting Hourly to Annual Pay in Australia

When you have an hourly rate or a salary offer, the first step is to understand the annual equivalent. The standard formula is **hourly rate × hours per week × 52**. This article assumes a 38-hour week unless stated otherwise, which is the full-time benchmark used by the Fair Work Ombudsman and the Fair Work Commission.

### The National Minimum Wage and Award Rates

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, $1,004.9 per week for 38 hours, and $33.05 per hour casual including 25% loading. Casual loading is added on top of the base rate. The timesheet has a checkbox for casual loading – never type a rate that already includes it.

Award rates and enterprise agreements often set higher minimums for specific industries. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides pay guides for each award. The reference tables on this site summarise common awards.

### The Average Salary in Australia Per Month

To find the average salary in Australia per month, start with weekly earnings. The Australian Bureau of Statistics Average Weekly Earnings for May 2026 shows full-time adult ordinary time is $2,083.7 per week for all employees. For all employees total earnings $1,579.2 per week (including part-time. This gives an annual figures: $108,344.4 per year or $9,028.7 per month for full-time. The all-employees average is $82,118.4 per year or $6,843.2 per month. These are averages across all industries, not a median for any particular job.

### Tax and Medicare Levy

Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale: nil to $18,200; 15% to $45,000; 30% to $135,000; 37% to $190,000; 45% above. Medicare levy generally 2%. The reduction thresholds for 2025–26 single reduction thresholds are used because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay.

### Superannuation

Super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings paid on top, up to $270,270. The maximum contribution base is $270,830. For a $52,269.44 annual, super is $6,272.33 per year. The timesheet estimates super on top of the annual figure.

### Fortnightly Pay

A fortnight is weekly × 2. For $26.44/hour, weekly is $1,004.9, fortnightly $2,009.8. For $33.05 casual, weekly $1,255.9, fortnightly $2,511.8.

### Using the Timesheet

The timesheet is the home page. Type your base hourly rate. Check the box for 25% casual loading. The calculator shows annual, fortnightly, monthly, tax, and super. It uses the 38-hour week assumption. It does not include unpaid overtime, penalty rates, allowances, or salary sacrifice.

### Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay.

## Conclusion

Understanding the average salary in Australia per month helps you compare offers. Use the formula, check the award, and check the timesheet. The estimate is not a determination.
